requirements.definition: The syntactic class constant-expr is expr. The expression grammar is owned by 10.1.2; this rule supplies the grammar head for contexts that require a constant expression.

requirements.title: Constant expressions admit only intrinsic operations and the listed constant primaries
requirements.definition: A constant expression is an expression suitable for kind type parameters, initializers, or named constants. In such an expression every operation is intrinsic and every primary is one of the listed constant forms, with recursive constant-expression requirements on constructor elements, intrinsic arguments, subscripts, section subscripts, substring bounds, and type parameter values.

pending.intrinsic-operations-only: PENDING positive-control named constant INTEGER,PARAMETER :: k = 1 + 2 * 3 and diagnostic/control using the same operands through a defined operator. Numeric interpretation is separately credited; this facet records intrinsic-only operation admission.
pending.constant-primary: PENDING positive-control named constants of integer, logical, character, real, and complex literal form used in initializers, with exact integer/logical/character or type-only real/complex checks reserved for fixture review.
pending.constant-array-constructor: PENDING positive-control INTEGER,PARAMETER :: a(*) = [(i,i=1,3)] or a fixed array constructor where each element and ac-implied-do control expression is constant; array constructor syntax remains 7.8.
pending.structure-allocatable-null: PENDING positive-control constant structure constructor for a type with an allocatable component initialized by NULL(), checking only constructor admission and not allocation status at runtime.
pending.structure-pointer-initialization-target: PENDING positive-control constant structure constructor for a pointer component associated with a valid initialization target; target lifetime and pointer rules are separately cited.
pending.structure-pointer-null: PENDING positive-control constant structure constructor for a pointer component initialized by NULL(), not comparing pointer representation and citing NULL separately.
pending.structure-other-constant-component: PENDING positive-control structure constructor whose ordinary component values are integer and character constant expressions, used as a PARAMETER initializer.
pending.enum-constructor-constant: PENDING positive-control enum constructor with a constant expr after enum type definition, used in a named constant or initialization context; enum ownership remains 7.6.1.
pending.enumeration-constructor-constant: PENDING positive-control enumeration constructor with a constant expr after enumeration type definition, used in a constant-expression context with 7.6.2 cited.
pending.specification-inquiry-constant-argument: PENDING positive-control constant expression using SIZE of an explicit-shape named array with constant bounds or LEN of a constant character entity, where every inquiry argument is a constant expression.
pending.specification-inquiry-variable-argument: PENDING positive-control constant expression using an inquiry of a variable whose inquired properties are explicit constant properties, not the variable value. The plan asserts only property inquiry, not variable-value constancy.
pending.assumed-property-excluded: PENDING diagnostic/control pair whose constant expression contains a specification inquiry of an assumed property and is repaired by changing only the entity to have the corresponding explicit constant property. The inquiry function and context remain valid.
pending.deferred-property-excluded: PENDING diagnostic/control pair querying a deferred property in an otherwise valid constant-expression inquiry, repaired to a nondeferred property without changing the constant-expression context.
pending.nonconstant-property-expression-excluded: PENDING diagnostic/control pair where the property inquired about is defined by a nonconstant expression, repaired by replacing only that defining expression with a constant expression.
pending.elemental-standard-intrinsic: PENDING positive-control named constant using an elemental standard intrinsic such as ABS(-3) or MERGE with constant arguments, with intrinsic-specific result rules cited to Clause 16.
pending.transformational-standard-intrinsic: PENDING positive-control named constant using an allowed transformational standard intrinsic such as RESHAPE or SELECTED_INT_KIND with constant arguments, avoiding excluded intrinsics and processor-dependent kind assumptions.
pending.transformational-excluded-intrinsics: PENDING diagnostic/control pair using one excluded transformational standard intrinsic such as COMMAND_ARGUMENT_COUNT or NUM_IMAGES in a constant expression, repaired to an allowed transformational intrinsic with constant arguments. The case must not depend on processor image count or command-line state.
pending.null-reference-limited-arguments: PENDING diagnostic/control pair using NULL with an argument whose type parameter is assumed or nonconstant-defined, repaired by making that type parameter constant or omitting the argument. Pointer context validity is cited separately.
pending.transfer-constant-arguments: PENDING positive-control named constant or initializer using TRANSFER with both SOURCE and MOLD supplied by constant expressions, paired later with a nonconstant-argument diagnostic/control. The oracle must not compare processor representation; it only establishes argument constancy admission.
pending.transfer-source-pointer-components-disas: PENDING diagnostic/control pair using TRANSFER with constant arguments but an associated ultimate pointer component of SOURCE, repaired by a disassociated pointer component. The oracle must not inspect representation bytes.
pending.ieee-transformational-function: PENDING positive-control using a transformational function from IEEE_ARITHMETIC or IEEE_EXCEPTIONS with constant arguments only after Clause 17 function semantics and module availability are registered.
pending.previous-kind-type-parameter: PENDING positive-control parameterized derived type definition where a previously declared kind type parameter of the type being defined appears in a constant expression for a later component.
pending.data-implied-do-variable: PENDING positive-control DATA statement with a data-implied-do variable appearing in a constant expression in the implied-do list, citing DATA statement syntax separately.
pending.array-constructor-do-variable: PENDING positive-control array constructor constant expression where the ac-do-variable appears in the element expression and all control scalar-int-exprs are constant expressions.
pending.parenthesized-constant-expression: PENDING positive-control initializer using nested parentheses around an established constant expression, e.g. INTEGER,PARAMETER :: k = ((1+2)), so only the parenthesized primary route is credited.
pending.constant-subscripts-and-type-params: PENDING positive-control using constant expressions as an array subscript, section subscript, substring bounds, and kind/len type parameter values in otherwise valid constant contexts, with no runtime out-of-bounds access.
pending.defined-operation-excluded: PENDING diagnostic/control pair using an otherwise valid defined operator in a constant expression, repaired to the equivalent intrinsic expression. The user-defined interface remains valid so rejection is attributable to p1's intrinsic-operation-only rule.
pending.ordinary-variable-excluded: PENDING diagnostic/control pair using a previously typed ordinary variable as the only nonconstant primary in a constant-expression context, repaired to a named constant of the same value. The type and declaration context remain otherwise valid.

requirements.title: Constant-expression inquiries of same specification-part entities use prior specifications
requirements.definition: If a constant expression includes a specification inquiry depending on a type parameter or array bound of an entity specified in the same specification-part, the type parameter or array bound is specified in a prior specification of that specification-part. The prior specification may be to the left in the same statement, but not within the same entity-decl unless the inquiry appears within an initialization.

pending.prior-type-parameter-specification: PENDING diagnostic/control pair where a constant expression inquiry depends on a same-specification-part type parameter. The repair specifies the parameter earlier; the invalid version differs only in declaration order.
pending.prior-array-bound-specification: PENDING diagnostic/control pair where a constant expression inquiry depends on a same-specification-part array bound. The control puts the bound in a prior specification; the invalid version leaves it later.
pending.left-same-statement-allowed: PENDING positive-control single statement with a left entity-decl establishing a constant bound or type parameter and a later entity-decl using a specification inquiry of it in a constant expression.
pending.same-entity-decl-initialization-exceptio: PENDING positive-control entity-decl whose initialization contains the specification inquiry allowed by the same-entity-decl exception, with the initialized entity otherwise valid and no value-content overclaim.
pending.same-entity-decl-noninitialization-exclu: PENDING diagnostic/control pair where the same-entity-decl inquiry appears outside initialization; the repair moves the depended-on specification earlier or moves the inquiry into an initialization context.

requirements.title: Generics used in constant expressions precede later specific procedures in the scoping or host unit

pending.no-later-host-specific-procedure: PENDING diagnostic/control pair where the later specific procedure is in the host scoping unit; the repair moves the host specific before the nested scoping unit constant expression.

review_rationale: batch105: independent fresh-context source review against pinned J3/24-007 (sha256 7371e889...), plus two closeout re-verifications. Reviewer read all 25 base units of 10.1.10, 10.1.11 and 10.1.12 in the original PDF rather than the author summary, verified 25 base / 105 fine units, 20 requirements and 117 facets (all pending), and independently confirmed the accounting claim that only 17 base units are newly accounted because the eight numbered units R1029, C1011, R1030, C1012, R1031, C1013, R1032 and C1014 were already accounted; each was checked as neither double-counted nor dropped, and using them as requirement identifiers rather than minting S identifiers matches earlier batches. The zero-permissions claim was independently adjudicated and accepted: every may, permitted only if and similar phrase in this constraint-dense scope admits a program construct conditionally rather than granting the processor latitude, including the TRANSFER permitted only if text, which is a restriction. Three rounds of findings were raised and closed. C10CSR-001 and C10CSR-003 are the same defect class: a facet may carry a diagnostic expectation only if the unit it is filed under actually prohibits something. 10.1.10 p1 defines an elemental operation and 10.1.11 p4 defines a specification function; neither prohibits anything, and a non-qualifying function in a specification expression is invalid through C1011 and p2, not through the definition. Both facet families were reclassified as classification or source-control evidence only, and the author's own sweep found and fixed a fourth instance at 10.1.11 p9. C10CSR-002 added the missing explicit dependencies for OPTIONAL and INTENT(OUT) attribute ownership reached by p2 item 2, verified in the pinned document at 8.5.10/R828/C845-C849 and 8.6.9/R852 for INTENT and 8.5.12/C851 and 8.6.10/R853 for OPTIONAL, with 15.5.2.1, 15.5.2.4 and 15.5.2.13 flagged as not yet registered. The author then produced a 38-row sweep table naming, for every remaining diagnostic plan, the exact prohibiting words and the single property distinguishing the invalid program from its control; the reviewer spot-checked twelve representative and high-risk row groups against the PDF, including the C1012 p1 family, the C1011 ordinary, OPTIONAL and INTENT exclusions, the S10.1.11-004 direct and indirect invocation pair, p6, p7, p8, C1013, C1014 and the 10.1.12 p2 and p3 rows, and found all sound. Final decision: accept, no blocking findings. This registers source accounting only: it is not fixture approval, it supplies no execution, and it approves no oracle.
